pokedexEntries.su: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

pokedexEntries.mo: When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.

pokedexEntries.us: The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.

pokedexEntries.um: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.

pokedexEntries.sh: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

pokedexEntries.sc: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

pokedexEntries.vi: It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey, then slices them with the rocks in its mane.
